items.title: Marshall Lawrence Interview, 1960-06-28
items.q: Well, Mr. Joe Stewart played the bass, and I know some of the members of the Pickwick band.

ctx.x: I wanted to get the names of some of these fellas straight. We were talking to Kid Thomas' daddy and he mentioned a lot of people.
Well, he used to play in the Pickwick band. Well, Mr. Joe Stewart played the bass, and I know some of the members of the Pickwick band.
